notes.title: Version 1.1.2 rolling out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Little update!

BUGS :
- Player was shooting fireballs from his body on level 1/2/3, it is now fixed! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/0fe1602660336a16a589080dce658facabbe2004.png[/img]
- Fixed a visual bug where dust would appear mid-air while running in big Alex on level 1/2/3.
- Fixed a bug preventing the Sound FX from level 1 to 3 to play.
- Fixed a bug preventing "In Between Games 3D" to launch.
- Fixed a bug preventing robots from detecting and rushing the player in level 4!

TWEAKS :
- Credit menu has been changed.
- Changed end level 3 text.
- In Between Games 3D demo has been changed a little.
- Level 7/8/9 Parallax water has been modified. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/7508c7ca2812a36ce7e6079e7312495b8d115a9a.png[/img]
- Your speed is now reset upon taking damage in level 7/8/9. 
- Added platforms in level 4.
- Removed the annoying platform in level 4. Yes THAT one! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/0626982958bf1ff1389c5ee68789ea69e69d73a2.png[/img]


I also want to point out that the website got revamped!
https://alexandressgames.wordpress.com/a-propos/

And I now have a twitter account! Follow me : https://twitter.com/AlexandressG

notes.title: Seagull Rage is out! Android users, I need you!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

I'm posting this news to inform you that my first Android game (and second game ever) has been released on the Play Store!

This is a simple "Endless Runner" but I hope you guys are going to like it!
You can get it here, for free : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AlexandressGame.SeagullRage

Don't hesitate to let a review if you liked it!

Thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/791c0296f438d5e841421ea7d21a98c60b56bc26.png[/img]

notes.title: In Between Games and the Soundtrack are on sale ! 23/01 - 27/01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Hello gamers!

Long time no see! I'm posting this news to inform you that "In Between Games" is now on sale! 50% off, so don't miss this occasion to buy it if you wish to give my game a try! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/6df30e0cf1dfdbf01aa547ffd4e5483c52c90d34.png[/img]

Also the Soundtrack is no longer a "DLC" type, it is now a "Soundtrack" type of contents, meaning you can now buy the soundtrack without buying the game. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/0626982958bf1ff1389c5ee68789ea69e69d73a2.png[/img]

Moreover the game still has cards and emotes waiting to be validated by Steam. We need more players to unlock this feature! [b]We need YOU![/b] 
Don't hesitate to let a review if you liked the game! It really helps a lot! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/356071b273d9571daffec40e6318d75eb9bb1f2e.png[/img]

---------------------------------------------

I'm currently planning to release a second game, on the playstore (Android) this time. It is not a very big ambitious game, but I hope you guys will give it a try once it is out! I will post another announcement for the release. It is called [b]"Seagull Rage"[/b].

Here is the main character of the game :

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/b1b963a1a74189fa720452ac6e4a0f55c3c0545c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31670675/776885d104b550d6b785a1b00c351f7a12ee0ed3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 rolling out!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Hello! Sorry for the lack of updates! I've been very busy with school, but here I am!
This is an update which fix some bugs that you guys reported, and also adds new features! An achievement, and a showcase of how would look In Between Games in 3D! Tell me what you think! ;)

BUGS :
- Player could fall infinitely in level 7/8/9. It has been fixed!
- Fixed a bug where you could still pick up items in level 1/2/3 while being dead.

TWEAKS :
- Lizard shooting across the map in level 7/8/9 has been changed. They now shoot if you're close to them.
- Some changes has been made in the Option menu.

NEW : 
- A teaser/demo is out for "In Between Games 3D"; the sequel of the game! You should use the Konami code on the main screen ;)
(It is still in a very early stage. It is simply to showcase the controls and the look of the game right now! Any feedback is welcome)
- A new achievement has been created! It may be linked to the Konami code...!

I also want to point out that the game will be on discount during the Summer Sales! :D
Don't miss it! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 rolling out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Hello! This update fixes some bugs (again) that you guys reported! But it also comes with a feature requested by a lot of you; a checkpoint for level 4 / 5 / 6! Enjoy! :D

BUGS :
- Player getting stuck in blocks from level 1 to 3 has been fixed
- Some blocks of level 8 has been fixed (You could fall under them without reason)


TWEAKS :
- There is now one checkpoint for level 4/5/6 ! This will make the game way more enjoyable and less frustrating!
- Yellow death particles in level 6 instead of orange like level 5. (I forgot to change it!)
- Some blocks from level 4/5/6 has been moved to make it more clear for the player which path to follow!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 rolling out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Hello! This update fixes some bugs that you guys reported. I also changed the hitboxes of the Main Screen so it is no pixel perfect anymore!

BUGS :
- Snail flying across the gap in level 1 has been fixed
- Jumping and Shooting sound FX playing while the player was dead or while the player was entering the castle/disappearing has been fixed (Level 1 to 6)


TWEAKS :
- The hitboxes of the Main Screen have been changed, as well as the Option ones. (It is no longer pixel perfect)
- The gamepad contouring has been polished and the commands on the picture as well.
- The layout of the level 5 has been modified a little, so you see clearly where you have to land
- Added a down arrow in level 4 to show the way (some people thought they were going into the void and where going to die)

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 rolling out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31670675/ff6ab4783f716a312c37f3ad9e2750fb7741ac70.png[/img]

Hello! This is a quick patch to fix some bugs that you guys reported and some tweaks to the controller controls! It also updates the OST! (The composers wanted to do some tweaks!)

BUGS :
- The gameover screen not showing up after death in level 1/2/3 has been fixed.
- The fact that you got stuck on the story screen has been fixed.

CONTROLLER :
- You need to press A instead of up arrow to Jump.
- You need to press X instead of A to shoot.

MUSIC :
- The OST has been "upgraded" fully! You can now check that out both in game and with the Soundtrack DLC!

Have fun! ːsteamhappyː
